title: Resampled Datasets Are Not Enough: Mitigating Societal Bias Beyond Single Attributes

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring spurious correlations between gender groups (e.g., man, woman) and image attributes in multi-label image classification and image captioning tasks using leakage and ratio metrics, alongside human evaluation for perceived gender.

Evaluating spurious correlations between binary skin tone categories (e.g., darker-skinned, lighter-skinned) and image attributes using leakage metrics in multi-label classification and image captioning tasks, alongside human evaluations using the Monk Skin Tone Scale.
